versions.changelog:
- Expanded supported shopping platforms in source options (added 全部, 苏宁, 唯品会, 考拉, 1688).
- Updated default search examples to use 全部平台 (source=0).
- Refined and clarified skill description for broader coverage.
- No code or file changes detected; documentation updates only.
- Updated installation requirements to use the correct package name: "aiohttp".

- Added detailed installation instructions for required dependencies in the metadata section.
- Clarified that the script requests product and price data from a third-party site.

- Initial release of the “maishou” skill.
- Search and compare product prices across major Chinese e-commerce platforms: Taobao, TMall, JD.com, PinDuoDuo, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
- Retrieve the best available prices and coupons for products.
- Provides product details and purchase links.
- Ensures scripts do not read or write local files and only request data from maishou88.com.
